source.description: Breeds of the Parker 2017 sample with their FCI classification, Wikidata names and image, Parker clade, origin point and editorial colour family. Each fact names its source in sources[].
notes: origin = FCI country (Paul, 2026-11-04); Wikidata P495 is a cross-check only, its disagreements are in data/reports/breeds.md.
Names are Wikidata labels with the first letter upper-cased, except English names overridden by data/manual/display-names.json (editorial, Paul 2026-11-09).
family is an editorial choice (docs/DESIGN.md §2), not genetic data.
development and fixedAround stay empty until a source gives them.
